composite_primary_role.rule: EA Composite DTM 1m may be primary raster only after real WCS/download bytes are observed; composite selection rule uses newest/best-resolution repeat survey but target lineage still must be resolved from metadata index.

timestamped_lineage.rule: Do not assume one transform or geoid globally. For each target, accept flight dates, resolution, transform and geoid only from the exact intersecting Time Stamped/National catalogue feature.

ground_truth_scope.rule: Plus/minus 3cm Ground Truth RMSE and survey QC thresholds validate survey processes only; they do not become parcel-specific uncertainty/confidence without a target-specific validation chain.

terrain50_secondary_role.rule: OS Terrain 50 4m RMSE is product-level accuracy and secondary corroboration only; do not replace EA DTM1m primary measurement or convert 4m RMSE into parcel confidence.

terrain50_datum.rule: Require actual target-tile metadata before crosscheck. EPSG:27700/EPSG:5701 and flying dates must be read from the downloaded tile metadata rather than inferred from product defaults.

numeric_claim.rule: No elevation, min/max/median/quartile, height difference, confidence or uncertainty may be written until exact target lineage plus actual raster/archive bytes are observed and NoData is excluded.

transport_fail_closed.rule: SAFE_OPEN_BLOCKED, DNS resolution failure and unsupported application/xml are transport/client failures and are not NO_DATA.
